verdicts.reason: A keeps the centered headline-over-CTA structure with even margins, but the LIMITED badge is cut loose at the far left, well away from the button. The headline wrap also leaves 'and a' trailing at the end of line 2. B blows the headline up so it fills the canvas, then pushes the CTA to the bottom-left and the badge to the bottom-right. Neither sits on the headline's center axis, the bottom margin is cramped, and the badge reads as a stray fragment instead of belonging with the CTA.
